constraints: deterministic: fixed task set, no randomness outside arm assignment

design.replication: 8 tasks x 4 arms = 32 runs, one observation per cell per task
design.type: blocked full factorial (2x2), generated by deepcli.observatory.doe.full_factorial
design.unit_of_observation: one executed run (one task under one arm) = one EXPERIMENT record

execution_environment: offline-deterministic: retrievers + fragment extractor run locally over committed repo docs at the pinned base_sha; compressed arm round-trips the context through the CedrLang compress/expand pair (workspace/compression_sandbox/cedrlang/cedrlang.py). The live-dispatch variant of #1849 (dormant-until-config levels on real lanes) remains specified, not run.

hypothesis.predeclared_threshold: compressed-arm mean accuracy within 0.10 of explicit-arm mean accuracy, with mean input tokens strictly lower
hypothesis.statement: CedrLang compression of the retrieved context preserves source-grounded task accuracy (required-fragment recovery) while reducing input tokens, and the effect does not depend on routing method (no routing x representation interaction large enough to reverse the token saving).

outcomes.primary: source-grounded task accuracy = required fragments recovered / required fragments
secondary: input_tokens (context tokens fed to the extractor)

quota_note: Offline execution: zero dispatch quota consumed. Live variant must be stated against the #1595 census before execution (per #1849).

required_fragments: never counts as the presenting surface's results
does not replace the deterministic scorer
One dispatched workflow run = one observation
Do not use latency as a correctness proxy
